policy: Only source-verified rules with passing validation cases may be enabled.

rules.statement: The article states that wherever natal Mars is placed, it implements/activates the 10th house from itself in the native's 27th year.
rules.source_author: Venkat Ramana, Saptarishis Astrology Re-Search Team
rules.source_title: Bhrighu Saral Paddathi – 6, Sage Bhrighu’s Blessings, Vol. 6
rules.source_location: PDF printed pages 368–374; BSP-6 statement at printed page 368; worked examples and publisher caution at printed page 369 onward

trigger.counting: inclusive house counting; natal Mars house is counted as 1

rules.confidence: Medium: primary Saptarishis magazine PDF, named author and multiple chart examples; publisher explicitly says it worked on approximately 25 charts and asks readers to test it, cautioning that success on 100 charts does not establish a siddhanta.

validation_case.limitation: The publisher explicitly warns that the technique is not a siddhanta merely because it works on many charts; charts and events still require independent recomputation.

rules.statement: In the 27th year, if a planet occupies the 10th-from-Mars house at exactly the same degree as natal Mars, that planet is influenced; if no such planet exists, Mars activates its Kakshya lord and that lord's significations.
rules.source_author: Venkat Ramana, Saptarishis Astrology Re-Search Team
rules.source_title: Bhrighu Saral Paddathi – 7, Sage Bhrighu’s Blessings, Vol. 6
rules.source_location: PDF printed pages 375–377; Kakshya table at printed page 376; same-degree rule and examples at printed pages 376–377

trigger.first: Search 10th-from-Mars house for a planet at exactly the same within-sign degree as Mars
trigger.fallback: If no same-degree planet exists, use natal Mars Kakshya lord

calculation.same_degree_match: Same integer degree within the sign (e.g. Mars 27°14′ and Venus 27°50′ are treated as matching in the worked example); minute-level tolerance is not separately specified.
calculation.fallback: Kakshya lord from eight equal 3°45′ slots; include lord's significations and owned houses

rules.confidence: Medium: primary Saptarishis magazine PDF, named author, explicit eight-slot table and multiple worked examples; the same-degree convention is inferred from the 27°14′/27°50′ example and needs a precise implementation note.

source_examples: BSP-7 examples 1–10 on the linked page
validation_case.limitation: The source's worked example shows 27°14′ Mars and 27°50′ Venus treated as the same degree number. The integer-degree interpretation is a source-based reading, not exact longitude equality; verify all chart examples before enabling.

rules.statement: Saturn's 3rd aspect implements in the native's 20th running year; the article defines this as after completing 19 years and before completing 20.
rules.source_author: Saptarishis Astrology page; byline metadata credits Vinayak Bhatt
rules.source_title: Bhrighu Saral Paddathi – 13 by Saptarishis Astrology
rules.source_location: Opening rule statement and running-year explanation; worked examples follow
rules.confidence: Medium-low: direct Saptarishis technique page; article notes results may shift plus/minus 1–2 years based on planetary strength and benefic/malefic aspects.

source_examples: Elizabeth Taylor example: article states 20th year Feb 1951–Feb 1952 and marriage 21 Feb 1952
validation_case.limitation: Strength/aspect timing modifiers are qualitative and need formal specification.

rules.statement: In the 32nd year, Jupiter implements its 5th aspect in the 5th house from its natal position; sometimes the same natal house is also implemented, and the 7th-from-Jupiter house may control or influence the result.
rules.source_author: Saptarishis Astrology; PDF metadata says data assistance by Venkat Ramana
rules.source_location: PDF page 1, rule BSP-11 and first two worked examples
rules.confidence: Medium-low: direct technique PDF with worked cases; the source itself describes a conditional secondary activation and requires contextual interpretation.

source_examples: 29 Aug 1969 native: 32nd year Aug 2000–Aug 2001; marriage Oct 2000
9 Sep 1963 native: 32nd year Sep 1994–Sep 1995; child birth 8 Oct 1994
validation_case.limitation: House-signification and modifier semantics need separate formalization.

rules.statement: In the 40th year, Jupiter implements its 9th aspect in the 9th house from its natal position and also implements the house in which Jupiter itself is located.
rules.source_author: Saptarishis Astrology Research Team; page byline metadata credits Vinayak Bhatt
